title: What makes the game file bigger?
instruction: Does the change make the game data bigger, or does it stay the same size?

items.why: Four times as many pixels, four times as many numbers.

items.text: A palette with 256 colours instead of 4
items.why: Each pixel needs 8 bits instead of 2.

items.text: You rename the file from hero.png to knight.png
items.why: The name doesn’t change the numbers inside.

items.text: You move the file to another folder
items.why: The data is still the same, just somewhere else.
Sound is numbers too; every second adds thousands of them.

debrief: More pixels, colours and frames mean more numbers, and so a bigger file. A different number in the same place doesn’t change the size.
